name: Commercial Refinishing Contracts in Bellevue: What Facility Managers Should Ask
title-tag: Commercial Floor Refinishing Contracts in Bellevue, WA
meta-description: The scope, schedule, insurance, and warranty questions that make two commercial floor refinishing bids comparable — written for Bellevue facility managers.
post-summary: April 9, 2027 · Four questions decide a commercial refinishing contract: what happens to the floor, when the building loses the space, what the contractor carries, and what happens afterward. A Bellevue facility manager’s checklist, with what a good answer looks like and what should worry you.
